# On12 Socks

> > Premium compression socks engineered specifically for healthcare professionals working extended 12-hour shifts.

On12 Socks is a specialized apparel brand focused on medical-grade compression wear designed for nurses and healthcare workers. The company leverages modern ecommerce infrastructure and digital marketing to reach its target audience.
